the breads prepared from the modified starches were significantly (p 5) higher than the control (100% wheat flour).

the acetylated starches were more effective in bread making.

the production and evaluation of bread made from cassava starches.
the production of wheat/cassava bread from modified cassava starches.
the production and evaluation of bread made from cassava starches and wheat flour blends.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, cassava starches can be used in the production of bread, but the quality of the bread produced depends on the starch source and the method of modification.
the bread samples made from acetylated cassava starches had the most acceptable sensory properties and could be used to produce bread.
, the acetylated cassava starches are the best for bread making and could be a good alternative to wheat flour in the production of bread.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
acetylated starches could be used in the production of bread with acceptable quality.
the modified starches were suitable for use in bread making.
cassava starches could serve as potential substitutes for wheat flour in bread making.
The main takeaway from our work is that
cassava starch can be modified and used to make bread with good sensory properties.
the acetylated starches have the potential to replace a portion of wheat flour in the production of bread.
cassava starches have potential for use in the production of wheat/cassava bread.
